svg.title: Lipid A and core oligosaccharide
svg.desc: Flat section of a Gram-negative outer membrane with rough lipopolysaccharide: lipid A heads and extra acyl chains in the outer leaflet carry a short core oligosaccharide of inner-core and outer-core sugars; periplasm, thin peptidoglycan and inner membrane below.
